title.evidence_quote: The Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships (QECS) offer a unique opportunity to study a two-year master's degree in a low or middle-income Commonwealth country.

qualifications: Applicants must also apply for admission to their chosen university course directly with the university, in addition to the QECS application
description_short: The Association of Commonwealth Universities' Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships support study for a two-year master's degree in a low or middle-income Commonwealth country. Applicants apply separately for admission to their chosen university course.

deadline.evidence_quote: Applications open: 26 November 2026 Applications close: 13 January 2027, 15:00 UTC
